notes: Rapid communication reporting the authors' own volumetric (Micromeritics ASAP 2010) H2 uptakes at 77 K, 0-1 bar, for 21 carbonaceous sorbents (activated carbons, activated carbon fibers, activated graphite, carbon nanofibers, synthetic graphite) and 15 silica/alumina/zeolite sorbents, with BET areas in Tables 1-2. The word 'survey' in the abstract refers to the authors' own measurement series, not a literature review, so not_primary does not apply. No retraction statement; is_retracted false. No statement that the uptake values were published before. Uptakes are in ml(STP)/g, labelled 'H2 total', with no basis definition.
